name: Dumbbell Overhead Press

instructions.description: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height and wrists stacked over elbows.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down to avoid arching your lower back.
Exhale as you press the weights overhead until your arms are straight without locking forcefully.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder level with control.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a controlled range and stable trunk position.
Record the total or per-hand load consistently.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Sit supported to reduce balance and trunk demands.

commentsNotes: Do not flare the ribs upward during the press.
Keep wrists neutral rather than bent back.
